tested_scope: One bounded official-GitHub documentation audit of content-addressed commit objects, ordinary refs/releases, and immutable releases as possible service-side freshness witnesses after repository history rollback.
observations: Commit lookup by SHA establishes content addressing but the API documentation does not state a permanent retention or monotonic freshness guarantee for an object no longer on current history.

GitHub history-rewrite documentation shows that old SHA-addressable material may remain available after a rewrite but also documents that GitHub can remove residual cached/reference visibility, so present existence is not a permanent witness guarantee.
Immutable releases lock their associated tag and assets after publication and GitHub documents protection against repository-name resurrection attacks.
Release immutability must first be enabled in repository or organization Settings and applies only to later releases.

result.reason_unreachable_commit: Content addressability does not provide documented permanent monotonic retention or freshness ordering.
result.reason_immutable_release: The persistence property is strong, but the documented feature-enablement step is outside the no-settings/no-protected-setup acceptance path, and this leaf found no documented single atomic operation coupling the witness to an arbitrary separate authoritative effect publication.

scope_guard: This result is limited to the four official documentation surfaces above. It does not claim that every GitHub service object has been audited or that immutable releases cannot be useful where their prerequisite setting is already independently available.
continuation: Part105: execute one bounded public-source leaf on default GitHub service-side IDs/tombstones that need no repository/org feature enablement. Audit issue/comment/release/repository IDs for non-reuse, deletion persistence, discoverability and write/read permissions; test whether any supplies a monotonic incarnation marker that can be coupled to repository-local CAS publication without a separate settings/protected/manual step. Reject finite-retention, deletable, undiscoverable, non-monotonic or separately committed markers and persist the next alternative witness class if none pass.
